channel.title: Pier & Point · P2
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for P2 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · P2: Mission Bay P2 now records the Assessor lots it overlaps.
item.description: Mission Bay P2 now records the Assessor lots it overlaps. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 3810006, 8710002.

item.title: Correction · P2: The October 10, 2026 note about this change said P2 lost about 220 square metres that overlapped the east reach. Measured again from the outlines before and after the change, P2 lost nothing and gained about 2,520 square metres, and the two shapes had overlapped by about 1,220 square metres. The P2 accuracy note also said twice that P2 overlaps the existing Mission Creek Park shape; it now says so once. The shape on the map is unchanged.

item.title: Correction · P2: P2 now starts at the crosswalk beside the Mission Creek Park Pavilion and no longer overlaps the east reach.
item.description: P2 now starts at the crosswalk beside the Mission Creek Park Pavilion and no longer overlaps the east reach. Source: Esri World Imagery, viewed 2026-10-10.

item.title: Added · P2: Added a sourced dossier for Mission Creek Park South Extension: P2 segment.
item.description: Added a sourced dossier for Mission Creek Park South Extension: P2 segment. Source: https://sfrecpark.org/1833/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Proje.

item.title: Correction · P2: P2 was shown as under construction. Construction has not started: SF Recreation and Park's Mission Creek Park South Extension page gives construction beginning late 2026 or early 2027 and no opening date yet. The walkable part of P2 today is the existing Huffaker Park path and community garden, which the project's schematic design says will be preserved, with the path repaved to city standards. P2 now shows as existing, not yet redeveloped; the expected construction start stays on its timeline.

item.title: Correction · P2: The P2 creek channel record's description, name and park use cited nothing. They now cite OCII's December 2019 Mission Bay Land Use Map (which labels P2) and SF Recreation and Park's Mission Creek Park South Extension project page (Parcels 2 and 8, a park along Mission Bay Drive and Channel Street). The record's 'under construction' status, set on 2026-09-20, is unchanged, but that page currently gives construction as beginning late 2026 or early 2027, so the status still needs a dated source or a further decision.

item.title: Expected · P2: Construction expected to begin 'Late 2026 / Early 2027' for the Mission Creek Park South Extension (parcels P2 and P8), per Rec and Park's project page; a July 2025 update said construction was expected to begin in 2026 with an 18-month duration (~2026)

item.title: Planned · P2: Successor Agency's Approved Long-Range Property Management Plan for Mission Bay lists Park P2 ("Vacant Lot/Land") as a designated Open Space Park Parcel under the 1998 OPA, assigned to the Phase II Future Parks group (2019 target, since superseded by the Mission Creek Park South Extension project's own schedule) (Dec 2015)
